citations.quote: The estate currently comprises 43 production services across 7 teams.
All 40 services are now provisioned through the module library.
It has no reporting line and no budget; it sets platform standards and reviews platform-adjacent designs.

rationale: The canonical service inventory lists 43 production services, not 400+, and the platform working group chaired by the candidate sets standards and reviews designs without a reporting line or budget, so the evidence does not support managing an estate of that size.
